subgroup_similarity.interpretation: The Atlas cross-link note added in T28 differentiates the atlas-covered subgroup from the non-atlas subgroup (cross-group mean ~0.91), but does NOT differentiate pages within either subgroup from each other (within-group means ~0.99-1.00). The non-atlas 9-page subgroup remains exactly as digit-normalized-uniform as the original pre-T28 90-page finding, just at 1/10th the scale.
